artifact.feeder_rationale: C: rule-area feeder deployment is allowed because the consolidated target measure expands to a bounded, metadata-proven set of leaf measures; feeders are emitted for each leaf measure individually, never for the consolidated element itself.

Sales:Total Cost.rationale: Compiles within the Phase 2 C: MVP subset: same-cube arithmetic, comparisons, where, case, and constrained metadata-resolved cross-cube align lookups over a metadata-proven, bounded leaf-measure expansion of the consolidated target.

required_metadata.description: Cube dimension order is needed for compile planning and deployment packaging.
Measure dimension identity is needed to place targets and validate rule scope.
Measure element types are needed to validate native rule targets and feeder sources.
Target measures must exist in cube metadata before native rule deployment.
C: rule-area compilation requires the target measure to resolve to a Consolidated element type.
C: rule-area compilation requires a bounded, metadata-proven leaf-measure expansion of the consolidated target, within the leaf-count ceiling.
Referenced measures must exist in cube metadata before compile planning and deployment.
The current native rule subset assumes numeric referenced measures.
